# QA / Test Plan Template

Use this template to capture the QA approach for a feature or release.

## Overview
- Feature / Project:
- Owner (PM):
- QA Lead:
- Target Release:

## Scope
- In-scope:
- Out-of-scope:

## Objectives
- Key goals of testing (e.g., validate acceptance criteria, prevent regressions)

## Test Strategy
- Types of testing to be executed (unit, integration, e2e, regression, exploratory)
- Automation coverage expectations
- Test environments (staging, pre-prod)

## Test Items / Test Cases
- Link to test case tracker or bulleted list of critical test cases

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clear pass/fail criteria for the feature

## Entry / Exit Criteria
- Entry: code merged to test branch, automated tests passing
- Exit: QA sign-off, all critical/blocker defects resolved

## Risks and Mitigations
- Known risks and planned mitigations

## Test Data and Environment
- Data requirements
- Environment configuration notes

## Schedule and Responsibilities
- Who will perform which tests and when

## Reporting
- How QA status will be reported (dashboards, daily updates)

## Post-release Validation
- Steps to validate in production after release
